The `(.+?)` for the message group (group 5) is non-greedy and followed by an optional `(?:\s+\[(.+?)\])?$`. FOLLOW: Miscategorised mypy diagnostics — error code captured from message text instead of the actual trailing `[error-code]`. Affects categorisation accuracy. Minor for PoC.
